# Remote Control Debug API (JSON-RPC over ZMQ)

## What was done

Implemented the full remote debug API for the ANEM16 simulator:

### New files created
- `debug_engine.h` / `debug_engine.cpp` — Pure-logic debug layer extracted from ANEMDebugger
- `jsonrpc.h` — JSON-RPC 2.0 request/response utilities (header-only)
- `debug_server.h` / `debug_server.cpp` — ZMQ-based debug server with REP+PUB sockets

### Modified files
- `debug.h` / `debug.cpp` — Refactored to delegate to DebugEngine (REPL preserved)
- `main.cpp` — Added `-r [port]` flag for remote mode
- `meson.build` — Added libzmq, cppzmq, nlohmann_json dependencies

### Architecture
```
ANEMDebugger (REPL) ─┐
                      ├── DebugEngine ── ANEMCPU
ANEMDebugServer (ZMQ) ┘
```

### Protocol
- REP socket (port N, default 6808): JSON-RPC 2.0 request/response
- PUB socket (port N+1, default 6809): Async notifications (stopped, trace)
- 17 RPC methods: step, continue, pause, breakpoint.*, watchpoint.*, registers, memory.*, disassemble, pipeline, trace, stats, reset, status

### Threading
- `continue` launches `std::jthread` running `engine.runBatch()` in loop
- Worker checks `pauseRequested` atomic + `stop_token` each batch
- Notifications queued via mutex, drained in main loop → published on PUB socket

## Verification
- Build: clean compilation (zero errors, only pre-existing periph.h warnings)
- REPL regression: step, breakpoint, registers, pipeline, stats all work identically
- Protocol: 11 end-to-end tests all passed (status, step, registers, pipeline, disassemble, memory.read, breakpoint+continue+notification, stats, trace, reset, method-not-found)
